scheduledPipelines.title: Daily job search
scheduledPipelines.lastRunNote: 9 new jobs added (1 Tier 1, 0 Tier 2, 3 Tier 3) — 28 total cumulative. 3 of today's 13 raw results excluded as content-duplicates of already-tracked postings under new connector-issued IDs: Circle "Lead Product Designer, Arc Platform" (re-surfaced as LinkedIn id 4353121371, already tracked as 4353051446/4352991507), Amazon Ring ACD (Indeed id 494, already tracked as 424/477/IN:JOBSEARCH_407), and Princeton10 ACD Art (Indeed id 496, already tracked as JOBSEARCH_479).

recommendations: The Amazon Ring ACD in today's Indeed results was posted February 28 — nearly 4 months ago. Indeed isn't filtering by recency, so stale roles are mixing in with fresh ones. Worth adding a "past 14 days" filter to Indeed searches so what surfaces is actually new.

2026-06-16: Confirmed the same job-ID-instability problem also affects LinkedIn, not just Indeed — Circle's "Lead Product Designer, Arc Platform" has now hit the pipeline under at least 3 different LinkedIn job IDs across separate days/tag-variants. all_jobs.json already carries 3 separate entries for the same Amazon Ring posting (ids 424/477/407) and nearly got a 4th today. Recommend a one-time cleanup pass on all_jobs.json to merge known duplicate clusters, plus switching dedup to a normalized title+company content hash going forward instead of relying on source-assigned IDs.
